about: Guidance for registering the look of a product as an industrial design in the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP (Abu Dhabi IP) guidance page on the checked date. AD.iP gives guidance and the filing is made with the Ministry of Economy, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The design must be new, non-obvious, ornamental, tied to a product, and two or three-dimensional
documents: Design drawings, representative drawings and description in Arabic and English
Memorandum of association and valid trade licence (companies only)
Power of attorney for individuals and companies registered outside the UAE
fees: Filing fees are paid at submission; amounts are not stated on the page
channels: A patent attorney or registered agent is recommended; AD.iP lists providers
AD.iP: 800555, Baniyas Towers, Abu Dhabi, Mon-Thu 8 am to 3 pm, Fri 8 am to 11:30 am
